# Read-only MCP server for engineering knowledge base

This module provides a read-only MCP (Meta-Compilation Process) server that exposes an interface for querying an already-compiled engineering knowledge base for a repository. It supports multiple workflows including test planning, entity inspection, impact analysis, and journey/test coverage queries. All answers are provenance-carrying and reflect the latest CI-compiled state; the server itself never triggers a recompilation and operates solely over the precompiled knowledge.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/mcp/server.py` — `knowledge_compiler.mcp.server.serve`
